# Repository AI Instructions

This repository uses shared AI instructions from sitecore.ai.sdlc.

## Specs

When working on a Jira ticket, check `/specs/` for a spec file matching the ticket ID (e.g., `PROJ-123-feature-name.md`). Use it as context for your work.

## Additional Instructions

Use OCP SDLC entry points for repository workflow tasks:

- `/ocp-help` for lane selection
- `/ocp-plan` for planning and ticket creation
- `/ocp-build` for implementation flow
- `/ocp-ship` for review, commit, PR, and completion workflow

Keep this file concise. Put detailed workflow behavior in prompts, skills, and scoped instructions.
